free_tier.stated: No longer offered. The developer upload and IPFS service was shut down. Was 5 GB free at launch (2025-05); the old web3.storage 1 TB free plan did not survive into Storacha.

egress.terms: N/A. Service closed. w3s.link, the Storacha/web3.storage gateway, now 301-redirects to dweb.link, which returns 429 with Retry-After: 900.

record.tooling: Previously @storacha/client, UCAN-based; CLI 'w3'. Repos remain but the hosted service is gone.
record.limits_note: Service wound down; users told to migrate 'by the end of May' (2026).
record.reliability_note: Data-loss event, not a throttle: the team joined Filecoin Foundation and the upload service shut down. The successor for the same shape is Fil One (S3, 1 TB free for 30 days = trial) and Filecoin Onchain Cloud / Filecoin Pin (paid per TiB).

evidence.proved: (2026-04-03) — 'The Storacha developer upload and IPFS service, however, will be shutting down.' 'you will have to move it — by the end of May at the very latest.'
(2025-05-27) — 'You can get started with 5GB for free!'

record.notes: No longer offered. The developer upload and IPFS service was shut down. Was 5 GB free at launch (2025-05); the old web3.storage 1 TB free plan did not survive into Storacha.
